figures.caption: Time-kill assays for Pepcon against exponentially growing bacterial strains of Staphylococcus epidermidis, S. aureus ATCC 43300, S. aureus ATCC 33591, S. aureus ATCC 29213, Salmonella enterica, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.Notes: Viability was counted at the indicated time points by serial dilution plating.
